## Service levels

- Video interpreter connected within 2 minutes for the top 20 languages, within 5 minutes for all others.
- American Sign Language available by video 24/7.
- Monthly quality report to Clinical Operations: connect times, dropped calls, and patient complaints.

## Notes

- Interpreters join Juniper visits through a guest link; Polyglen staff never get access to Meridian EHR.
- Family members should not interpret clinical conversations except in emergencies (see patient intake procedure).
- Renewal discussions start in November 2026. Clinical Operations wants to add Haitian Creole and Karen to the 2-minute tier.
